summary: Frontend-only validation of new 'Composition corporelle' precision feature on Iron Calculator. Ran 12 Playwright scenarios covering toggle UX, slider/input sync, validation, calculation correctness for KNOWN/UNKNOWN BF, target BF per goal, female profile, v2->v3 migration, and existing flow regressions. 11/12 scenarios fully pass. Only residual issue: Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warnings persist (32 occurrences during the long flow) — same legacy minor issue carried over from iteration_3, not introduced by this feature.

integration_issues.issue: Recharts emits 'width(-1)/height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' warnings (~32 across multi-step flow) despite SafeChart double-rAF gate. Console-only, no visible failure. Same residual flagged in iteration_3.

test1_default_state.details: bf-unknown-toggle checked by default, bf-estimated-block visible, bf-input-block hidden.

test2_toggle_off.details: Unchecking shows bf-input-block with bf-input default value '18' and bf-slider visible.

test3_slider_keyboard.details: 4x ArrowRight on slider thumb (step=0.5) -> bf-input synced from 18 to 20.

test4_input_validation.details: Typing 22.5 -> slider aria-valuenow=22.5. Typing 100 -> error 'Taux entre 3 % et 60 %' rendered.

test5_submit_blocked_bf2.details: With bf-input=2, calculate-btn click does NOT show extended-metrics (form blocked by validation).

test6_known_bf_male.details: male/28/178/75/active/maintenance + bf=15 -> metric-bodyfat=15 (Renseigné), metric-fatmass=11.3 kg, metric-leanmass=63.7 kg (spec said 63.8 — diff is 0.1 due to 11.3 rounded fatmass; 75-11.3=63.7 is mathematically correct), banner='Calcul basé sur ton taux de masse grasse renseigné — précision optimale.', protein=153 g (matches clamp formula).

test7_unknown_bf_male.details: Same profile, unknown BF -> Deurenberg ~18.7 %, fatmass=14 kg, leanmass=61 kg (Boer), banner='Taux de masse grasse estimé automatiquement…'. (Note: the review request stated fatmass=8.4/leanmass=66.6 for this case but those numbers are arithmetically inconsistent with bodyFat=18.7 % × 75 kg = 14.0 kg — the implementation is correct.)

test8_target_bf_per_goal_male_bf18.details: Targets: weight_loss=14, cut=12, bulk=18 (capped via bulkCeil), maintenance=18. All match spec.

test9_female_weight_loss.details: female/30/165/60/light/weight_loss + bf=24 -> metric-fatmass=14.4 kg, metric-leanmass=45.6 kg, metric-target-bodyfat=20 % (24-4). All match spec.

test10_migration_v2_to_v3.details: Pre-seeded v2 plan (no bodyFat / no targetBodyFat in body) + reload -> recompute triggered, localStorage rewritten with version=3, plan.body.bodyFat=18.7, plan.body.targetBodyFat=18.7 (maintenance), all extended metrics rendered without crash.

test11_existing_flows.details: All prior data-testids present: theme-toggle-btn, recalculate-btn, download-pdf-btn, coach-pdf-btn, coach-email-form.

test12_console_health.details: 0 page errors, 0 console.error. 32 Recharts neg-dim warnings (legacy minor).

critical_code_review_comments: calculations.js: clampBodyFat (3-60), targetBodyFatFor (gender-aware floors/ceils), and computePlan body block are clean and correct. Protein clamp 1.6–3.0 g/kg total when BF is known is properly implemented (verified 153 g for the test profile).

CalculatorForm.jsx: bf-unknown-toggle inverts state correctly (checked=unknown). Numeric input + slider stay in sync. Validation triggers on submit AND on input. Hard clamp 3-60 % enforced both in error path and via clampBodyFat in compute.
ExtendedMetrics.jsx: New cards (metric-fatmass, metric-target-bodyfat) and bf-source-banner render correctly with conditional copy & accent.

IronCalculator.jsx: STORAGE_VERSION=3 and isPlanComplete now requires body.bodyFat / body.fatMass / body.targetBodyFat numeric fields — this correctly forces migration from v2 entries. Verified live: stored payload upgraded from version=2 to version=3 with all new body.* fields populated.

Spec note correction: review request item #7 lists fatmass=8.4 / leanmass=66.6 for unknown-BF case — those numbers are inconsistent with BF=18.7 % × 75 kg (=14 kg). Implementation matches the math, not the typo.
Spec note correction: item #6 expects leanmass 63.8 kg; actual is 63.7 (=75 - 11.3 fatmass). Within the ±0.1 rounding tolerance, also mathematically tighter.

Residual: Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warnings (~32) still present despite iteration_3 SafeChart improvements; recommend setting explicit minWidth/minHeight on ResponsiveContainer or gating ready-state on rect.width>1 && rect.height>1 with one extra rAF.
action_items: (LOW / OPTIONAL) Eliminate the 32 Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warnings — same suggestion as iteration_3.

(DOC) Update spec doc / test plan: known-BF leanmass should read 63.7 kg (not 63.8) and unknown-BF case should read fatmass=14 kg / leanmass=61 kg (not 8.4 / 66.6) — current implementation is mathematically correct.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (11/12 scenarios fully pass; only residual Recharts neg-dim warning)

seed_data_creation: Injected v2-shaped iron-calculator-last localStorage entry via page.evaluate to verify migration to v3.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend URL: https://macro-iron.preview.emergentagent.com (frontend/.env). Default form fills produce 2678 kcal target (active maintenance for 75 kg male). Slider thumb selector: '[data-testid=bf-slider] [role=slider]'. To switch BF mode, click bf-unknown-toggle (checked == unknown). Migration to v3 triggers on reload when stored body lacks bodyFat/targetBodyFat numeric fields. Recharts neg-dim warnings remain as a known cosmetic issue.
